answer: The juniper counter is kept in nebula and willow shows each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 45 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
